title: Le creuset utensils and crock
text: Le creuset utensils and crock. I purchased this for my daughter who has a lovely collection of Le creuset in Indigo.  She loves it.  The handles are wood (don't machine wash)- the utensil tips are a silicone/or like.  The crock is ceramic and matches her ceramic and cast iron pieces beautifully.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Le Creuset Silicone Craft Series Utensil Set with Stoneware Crock, 5 pc., Indigo
features: Flexible silicone tip scrapes bowls clean
description: This set of silicone Utensils is the full assortment of our craft series range. It’s perfect for outfitting a new kitchen or complementing a Le creuset collection. A stoneware crock keeps tools organized.
